verificationScope: Official or authoritative primary service pages were checked for the contact details shown.
notLive: Nothing on the site imports this file. content/hotlines.ts is the single live fixture and the only place a rendered number comes from. This file is kept because DECISIONS.md and records/consolidation-register.md name it; N-260 (2026-09-04) split its combined United Kingdom and Republic of Ireland region into the five separate services those nations actually run, so that a stale duplicate cannot contradict the fixture if anything ever reads it.

privacy.warning: Internet and device use can be monitored and may be impossible to erase completely.
saferOptions: If it is safe, use a device the controlling person cannot access.
Consider a trusted person's phone, a library device, or another safer connection.
Private browsing can reduce local history, but it does not hide activity from device monitoring, networks, employers, or account-level logs.
Calls and texts may appear in device records or bills depending on the service and account.
